# topics.txt -- the topic branches that make up cove-patches-<upstream tag>, in
# the order assemble.sh merges them (git merge --no-ff, one merge per line).
#
# Syntax, one entry per line; '#' starts a comment, blank lines are ignored,
# fields are separated by spaces:
#
#   @upstream <tag>                       the upstream tag the line is built on
#                                         (assemble.sh --base overrides it)
#   <branch> [base=<branch>]... [never-upstream]
#
#   <branch>        a topic branch name; assemble.sh reads it as
#                   <prefix><branch> (--prefix, empty by default: the local
#                   branch; origin/ for the fork's remote branches).
#   base=<branch>   the topic is stacked on <branch>, an entry listed above
#                   it; repeat for each topic it contains. The base must be an
#                   ancestor of the topic. A topic with no base= sits directly
#                   on the upstream tag.
#   never-upstream  the topic is fork-only and is never offered upstream.
#
# Every topic must contain the upstream tag's commit. A topic that upstream
# took is not deleted from history: it moves to the dropped block at the end,
# as a comment, so it is never merged.
#
# Order: the fork-only topics first, then the rest in the v55 port map's
# order. musl-seccomp-allowances is fork-only too, but it is stacked on
# block-discard-offload, so it keeps its place in the map's order.

@upstream v55.0

# Fork-only.
topic/fork-readme                                   never-upstream
topic/fork-ci                                       never-upstream
topic/fork-release       base=topic/fork-ci          never-upstream
topic/fork-release-tests base=topic/fork-release     never-upstream

# Upstreamable, in map order (rows 1-14, then 18).

topic/iouring-worker-cap      base=topic/musl-seccomp-allowances base=topic/iouring-eagain-retry
topic/cow-restore-virtio-mem
